text:
amy (AE): Hey team — Veridian Health is asking to convert their 3-month POC into a 12‑month committed Dedicated plan. They're asking for a bespoke 28% discount off list for the committed capacity. Need deal-desk + finance signoff. TL;DR: healthcare customer, PHI risk, private deployment likely. 

sam (Deal Desk): Can you drop the basic numbers? list vs discounted ARR, any additional concessions (SLA, onboarding, credits)?

amy (AE): Sure. Quick numbers below. They're targeting 500M tokens/month steady state after ramp (month 2). List price assumed: $0.08 per 1k tokens for committed plan. Asking 28% off on the base commit. No extra credits asked, they want a 99.9% SLA and SOC2 + BAA. 

amy (AE): ```
List monthly commit: $40,000
28% discount -> $28,800/month
Annualized (12 mo) -> $345,600
Expected net revenue YOY (post-discount) -> $345.6k
```

marco (Finance): 28% seems steep for a 12mo commit on Dedicated. What's our blended gross margin at that discount assuming avg GPU utilization? We need to see unit economics. Also which region? Egress costs could matter.

lina (RevOps): Quick calc: if list $40k/mo -> 28% cut = $11.2k discount/mo. If our cost of service ~ $12k/mo (estimate), margin is ~(28.8k-12k)/28.8k ~ 58%. Need exact infra cost to confirm. I'll pull the cost model.

nate (SE): Security check: Veridian will require a BAA and want data to stay in VPC/on-prem. We should plan for Private deployment or a VPC Dedicated. That changes ops cost and timeline (~4-6 weeks). Julies, is BAA ok?

julie (Legal): BAA will be required for PHI. We can sign but need procurement review and indemnity caps in SOW. Also confirm whether customer requires logging/audit retention > standard — might need an addendum.

sam (Deal Desk): Two quick asks for approval path: 1) Does Sales Ops have authority for up to 20% pre-approved? 2) Anything >20% needs Finance + CRO signoff. Can you confirm margin if we do 28%?

marco (Finance): If Lina's cost estimate holds, margin is OK but we're tight on buffer for burst capacity. Approving 28% will require CRO ok and a short note that this is convertible to a 24% baseline after 6 months if usage < 70% of committed. Suggest conditional approval.

amy (AE): That conditional rollback is fine to propose. Customer wants the price locked for 12 months though. Would it be acceptable to offer a 26% discount firm + an additional 2% rebate paid quarterly if they hit the 500M tokens target? That keeps list price cleaner and preserves CFO comfort.

lina (RevOps): I like the rebate structure; easier to track. If we do 26% up-front and 2% earn-back by SLA/usage, our immediate margin improves and finance should be happier. I'll update the quote template.

marco (Finance): Okay — finance can approve 26% with 2% earn-back tied to usage and a clause to reprice if sustained utilization <70% after month 3. Also require the contract to state Private deployment specifics and pass-through infra costs if they request on-prem. 

julie (Legal): I'll draft BAA + SOC2 clause and add the reprice trigger language. Need AE to confirm which datacenter region (US-East / GovCloud?).

amy (AE): Confirmed: US-East for now, potential GovCloud later. I'll tell Veridian the counter: 26% off + 2% quarterly earn-back if they hit committed token thresholds, BAA required, private/VPC deployment with a possible add-on for on-prem. 

sam (Deal Desk): Recording for the deal desk: Approved discount = 26% upfront, 2% contingent rebate (quarterly) — requires Finance and Legal to attach clauses. CRO to be informed; if CRO wants to sign off I'll loop them in. @ops-bot note: ensure dedicated pool sizing estimate included.

ops-bot: [automated] New request logged: veridian-health-dedicated-sizing-1719876543. Assigning infra estimate to eng-ops. ETA 48 hours.

amy (AE): Thanks all. I'll present this counter to the customer and update the opportunity with the new pricing and attachments. If CRO signoff is needed I'll ping here. :+1:

nate (SE): FYI — I'll prep the onboarding checklist and a short runbook for the Private deploy to speed the 4-6 week timeline.

marco (Finance): Noting final: conditional approval documented. If use-case or region changes materially, reopen pricing.

amy (AE): Closing the loop — customer verbally accepted the 26% + 2% earn-back structure, asked for legal + BAA. I'll upload signed docs when ready. Thanks everyone. :tada:
